answer: An island certifies a haven only when that haven shows more epochs of judged work than the whole nebula already holds, and a haven joins a nebula only by vouching for an earlier haven of it, so a fresh purse cannot restart the tally. An honest maker's first haven shows one epoch; the k-th clone must show 2^(k-1) epochs, so a maker of a thousand havens owes 2^1000 epochs of judged work, and no cluster of machines can split that work.
